name: vpa-ignores-margins
about: VPA is absolute on the SCREEN, not relative to the margins, so with margins 2..4 a VPA to row 4 lands on screen row 3 where a CUD of the same distance stops at the bottom margin. scripts/wterm-0.5.0-roost.patch, CSI 'e' is routed to cursorDownToScreen rather than cursorDown.
patch: CSI e routes to cursorDownToScreen, which is bounded by the screen and not by the margins
diverges_from_v2: The v2 patch routes CSI e to cursorDownToScreen, bounded by the SCREEN. alacritty_terminal makes VPA margin-relative, so it lands on the bottom margin.
